children: Allarity Therapeutics announced a SPAC sponsor has filed an S-1 for a proposed $100M IPO (up to $115M with overallotment) and will own ~25% post-offering.
Allarity Acquisition Corp. filed a Form S-1 for a proposed unit IPO with a $100M base size, $115M with full overallotment.
ALLR Sponsor LLC, a wholly owned Allarity subsidiary, is expected to own ~25.0% of the SPAC after the offering.
SPAC may target any industry/region; units applied to list on Nasdaq under symbol "ALLNU" (Class A "ALLN", warrants "ALLNW").
Maxim Group LLC named sole book-running manager; registration statement is preliminary and not yet effective.
Offering does not change Allarity’s prior view that it has sufficient working capital to fund operations into summer 2028.
